jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Software Engineer – Integrations & API Connectivity

Overview
Mastercard is a global technology company powering an inclusive, digital economy, enabling secure and seamless transactions across 210+ countries.
This role sits within Mastercard’s Open Finance Europe – Connectivity team, responsible for building and operating scalable API integrations with financial institutions across Europe.
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key hands-on contributor responsible for designing, building, and operating secure, reliable backend services. You will work on complex engineering problems, contribute to system design decisions, and deliver high-quality solutions that operate at scale in production environments.

Role-What You’ll Do
• Design, develop, test, and support scalable APIs and backend services
• Contribute to system design decisions with a focus on scalability, resilience, and performance
• Deliver high-quality, production-ready code across the full software development lifecycle
• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring system stability and reliability
• Participate in code reviews and uphold engineering best practices and standards
• Implement effective testing strategies (unit, integration, end-to-end)
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Architecture, Security, and SRE
• Improve observability, automation, and operational efficiency across services

Technology Stack
• Backend: C#, .NET, Web APIs
• Cloud: Azure (App Services, KeyVault, Blob Storage), AWS (S3, Redis, Microservices)
• Data: PostgreSQL, Flyway
• Practices: CI/CD pipelines, observability, secure development
• Plus: Java / Spring Boot, AI-assisted tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot)

All about you-What You Bring - Required
• 3-5 years of professional software engineering experience
• Strong hands-on experience building cloud-based, distributed backend systems
• Solid expertise in API development, scalability, and production support
• Ability to solve complex technical problems with a structured, pragmatic approach
• Strong understanding of SDLC, testing practices, and secure coding principles
• Proven ability to own and deliver components/services independently
• Strong collaboration and communication skills

Preferred
• Experience in payments, banking, or Open Banking (PSD2) environments
• Experience working with microservices architectures
• Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and incident response practices
• Exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot)

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

•

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

•

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

•

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

•

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The Applied Foundations team at OpenAI is dedicated to ensuring that our cutting-edge technology is not only revolutionary but also secure from a myriad of adversarial threats. We strive to maintain the integrity of our platforms as they scale.

The Applied Foundations team is at the front lines of defending against financial abuse, scaled attacks, and other forms of misuse that could undermine the user experience or harm our operational stability. Integrity Foundations provides the core building blocks and infrastructure for this work.

About the Role

At OpenAI, our mission is to advance AI in a way that is safe, reliable, and aligned with broad societal values. The applied foundations role is crucial for maintaining the trustworthiness of our platforms. You will be pivotal in developing robust defenses against a spectrum of adversarial behaviors that threaten our ecosystem.

Amazon Flex works directly with independent contractors – called delivery partners – to make deliveries to our customers. With Amazon Flex, individuals can now be their own boss delivering Amazon packages. Amazon Flex is powered by a mobile app that works in concert with our advanced logistics systems that allows delivery partners to on-board, schedule delivery times, guide them through their deliveries with in-app mapping and navigation, and more.

Amazon Flex's Service Level Standards (SLS) team is seeking a Litigation Risk Manager to join our Critical Operations function. Our team ensures that enforcement actions taken against delivery partners are fair, defensible, and well-documented — and when those decisions are contested through legal channels, we investigate thoroughly.

As a Litigation Risk Manager, you will play a crucial role in managing legal disputes arising from delivery partner enforcement actions. You'll be responsible for conducting in-depth investigations into contested offboarding decisions, developing disposition recommendations for legal proceedings, and serving as a subject matter witness when required. This role offers the opportunity to work with cross-functional teams - including legal, outside counsel, enforcement program owners, and regulatory stakeholders - while directly contributing to the protection and compliance of Amazon's last-mile delivery operations.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct end-to-end deep-dive investigations into contested delivery partner enforcement actions, determining whether offboarding decisions adhered to established policies and procedures

- Develop and deliver well-reasoned disposition recommendations for active litigation and arbitration matters

- Serve as a subject matter witness in arbitration hearings, tribunal proceedings, and regulatory inquiries - articulating the company's enforcement rationale clearly and accurately

- Partner closely with internal legal teams and outside counsel to align on case strategy, timelines, and desired outcomes
- Monitor and manage caseload with competing priorities, jurisdictional deadlines, and strict SLAs

- Identify emerging litigation trends, recurring claim patterns, and systemic risks across jurisdictions
- Provide closed-loop feedback to enforcement program owners to proactively address root causes of disputes
- Identify opportunities for workflow efficiency improvements and contribute to process optimization
- Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure responses are accurate, comprehensive, and delivered on time

COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

KKR's Technology team is responsible for building and supporting the firm's technological foundation, including a globally distributed infrastructure, information security, and the application and data platforms. Within Technology, the ADAPT team (Application, Data and AI Platform Team) owns the firm's engineering platform, developer experience, AI tooling and the SaaS integration fabric that connects our core enterprise systems. ADAPT drives a culture of technology excellence through workflow automation, self-service tooling, and modern integration patterns across AWS, Jira / Jira Service Management / Confluence, ServiceNow, and adjacent SaaS estates. The team partners with application engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business functions to deliver agility, resilience, and high impact at global scale.

POSITION SUMMARY

KKR is seeking a Vice President, Platform Engineering to lead a technical projects within the ADAPT team, focused on the AWS-native platform, our Atlassian and ServiceNow ecosystems, and the cloud integrations that connect them to the firm's business systems. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will own the strategy and delivery for developer-facing platform services, integration patterns, and automation that materially improve engineering velocity and operational quality. You will partner with peers across Technology, Cybersecurity, and the business to modernize the firm's toolchain, retire bespoke glue code in favour of well-governed integration platforms, and set the standard for how platform engineering is done at KKR. The successful candidate combines deep AWS and integration engineering expertise with the leadership judgement to shape a multi-year roadmap and mentor a global team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Platform Strategy & Roadmap: Own the vision and multi-year roadmap for the ADAPT platform – AWS-native services, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and the integration fabric spanning Atlassian, ServiceNow, and adjacent SaaS. Translate business priorities into a prioritized delivery plan.
• AWS Cloud Engineering: Lead the design, build, and operation of secure, scalable AWS foundations (accounts, networking, IAM, EKS/ECS, serverless, data services). Drive Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), landing-zone patterns, and cost, resilience, and security guardrails.
• Atlassian & ServiceNow Platform Ownership: Own the engineering strategy for Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and ServiceNow – including platform administration standards, workflow design, app/plugin governance, and roadmap alignment with HR, IT Service Management, and business users.
• Cloud Integrations & Automation: Architect and deliver enterprise integrations between AWS, Atlassian, ServiceNow, Workday, and other core SaaS platforms using event-driven and API-first patterns (REST/GraphQL, webhooks, iPaaS/EventBridge, Kafka). Replace bespoke scripts with well-governed, observable, reusable integration services.
• Developer Experience & Enablement: Build the paved roads, reusable components, and self-service tooling that accelerate the software development lifecycle. Establish and evolve CI/CD standards, developer portals, and internal APIs that reduce cognitive load for application teams.
• Operational Excellence & Security: Ensure the ADAPT platform meets the firm's availability, security, and compliance requirements. Partner with Cybersecurity on secure-by-design controls, secrets management, and identity federation across the integration surface.
• Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with application engineering, HC Technology, IT Operations, and business stakeholders to understand needs, sequence delivery, and land change successfully. Represent ADAPT in senior technical forums and vendor relationships.
• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Partner with a team of platform and integration engineers across geographies. Set the technical bar, review designs, and evangelize modern platform engineering practices across KKR Technology.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced technical degree a plus.
• 10+ years of hands-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or cloud/integration engineering, including 3+ years leading senior technical projects.
• Expert-level, hands-on experience with AWS (compute, networking, IAM, container/serverless services) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
• Deep experience delivering enterprise integrations across Atlassian (Jira / JSM / Confluence) and ServiceNow, including workflow design, APIs, webhooks, and third-party app governance.
• Strong track record designing event-driven, API-first cloud integrations between SaaS platforms (e.g., AWS ↔ ServiceNow) using iPaaS, EventBridge, Kafka, or equivalent patterns.
• Fluent in modern CI/CD, containerization (Kubernetes/Docker), observability, and secure-by-design cloud architecture; strong programming/scripting skills (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java).
• Demonstrated success delivering platform and developer-experience improvements with measurable impact on velocity, reliability, or cost.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills; able to influence engineers, business partners, and senior leadership. Experience in financial services or another regulated environment preferred.

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

• Technical depth and pragmatism – makes sound architectural choices grounded in real production experience across AWS, Atlassian, and ServiceNow.
• Systems thinking on integrations – sees the full data and event flow across SaaS platforms and designs for resilience, observability, and governance rather than point fixes.
• Developer empathy – relentlessly focused on reducing friction for application engineers through paved roads and self-service.
• Delivery orientation – sequences and lands complex, cross-team change on realistic timelines; balances long-term platform investment with near-term business outcomes.
• Leadership and mentorship – attracts, develops, and retains strong engineers; sets a clear technical bar and gives direct, useful feedback.
• Stakeholder influence – communicates clearly with technical and non-technical audiences and builds durable partnerships across Technology and the business.
• Operational and security mindset – treats availability, resilience, and secure-by-design as first-class outcomes, not afterthoughts.
• Curiosity and continuous learning – tracks the evolving cloud, platform, and integration landscape and applies it judiciously to KKR's context.

What We're Looking For

Core Competencies:

• Enterprise deployment ownership: has driven AI/ML or complex/real-time software products from contract to production at scale — including near-zero-to-one, with no real users yet — with real integration, real security constraints, and real change management.

Must-Have:

• Active TOP SECRET security clearance (TS/SCI eligibility preferred).
• 6+ years in product management, technical program management, or a customer-facing product ownership role
• Direct experience working with the U.S. Department of War (DoW) or the broader U.S. national security community.
• Working knowledge of at least one of the following, with an ability to speak credibly to the other:

• The military planning process (e.g., the Joint Planning Process) and modeling/simulation systems (e.g., AFSIM).
• Real-time streaming data systems — event-driven architectures, low-latency pipelines, and high-throughput data processing — and how they behave in production.

• Demonstrated record of shipping AI or data products into large, constrained, classified, or highly regulated organizations — not pilots or proofs-of-concept. You can name the customer, the scale, the integration, and what production actually looked like.
• Extreme ownership and follow-through: closes loops without reminders, drives outcomes across teams without formal authority, holds self and others to commitments.
• Comfortable operating with senior military/civilian/mission stakeholders and senior engineers simultaneously; credible presence in high-stakes rooms on both sides.
• Strong judgment under pressure: makes good calls quickly with incomplete information, knows when to escalate vs. resolve, does not generate thrash.
• Technical fluency sufficient to hold a real conversation with a platform engineer about architectural tradeoffs — not deep coding, but genuine comprehension of how systems work in production.
• Ability to shape a cross-cutting set of solutions across multiple stakeholders and use cases, rather than customer-specific solutions.
• Ability to travel, including to classified facilities.

Nice-To-Have:

• Direct experience with AI/ML platform products — agentic capabilities, human-agent interaction, large-scale data, some T&E; or data labeling, RLHF, fine-tuning workflows, and model evaluation pipelines.
• Hands-on familiarity with streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Kinesis) or the operational systems that consume them.
